summary: Iteration 65 — full E2E test of 3 new features (AI Status Report, Jira read-only connector, Home objectives-drift). Backend: 11/15 pytest passed. Frontend: AI Report modal renders correctly with all content sections + PDF/Email/Regenerate buttons, portfolio Jira badge (WEB 34/50 68%) OK, /home drift block works end-to-end (set 9 → drift shown 'Réalisé 11 → 9 % · cible 15 % · 60% de la cible', click navigates to /objectifs, restore 11 → drift disappears). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: ConnectorModal crashes with 'ReferenceError: links is not defined' as soon as the Jira 'Projets liés' tab is opened — the entire project-links UI is unusable.

minor.issue: Returns 200 for viewer@altair.fr, but review expected 403. Viewer role currently has permission 'export.status_report' → router allows access. Either strengthen the required permission (e.g. 'ai_report.generate') or revoke 'export.status_report' from READ_ONLY. Mismatch between spec expectation and permission model.
Same as above — viewer can generate AI report (200) because they hold 'export.status_report'. Generating a report is a write/costly operation; recommend a stronger permission.
Same permission issue — viewer can download the PDF.

Returns 200 for viewer instead of expected 403 (spec says permission admin.config). Router does not call _require_admin_config on GET config; only masked payload is returned. Response IS properly masked (api_token = '••••••••'), so risk is low, but does not match spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: 'links is not defined' when clicking Jira tab 'Projets liés' (connector-tab-links). Variables `links` and `setLinks` are used at line 286 (handleSave payload) and line 369 (<JiraLinksTab links={links} setLinks={setLinks} />) but never declared with useState in ConnectorModal. Must add: `const [links, setLinks] = useState((connector.field_mapping?.project_links || []).map(l => ({...l})));`. Breaks the entire Jira project-linking feature in the UI.

integration_issues.issue: Tab click crashes the app (React error overlay). Consequently, data-testids jira-links-tab / jira-link-project-0 / jira-link-key-0 / jira-link-add / jira-link-remove-* cannot be reached from the UI.

action_items: URGENT: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Connectors.jsx ConnectorModal, declare `const [links, setLinks] = useState((connector.field_mapping?.project_links || []).map(l => ({...l})));` alongside other state declarations (~line 237). Without this the Jira project-links tab is completely broken.

Decide the intended permission model for AI Status Report endpoints — either introduce a dedicated permission (e.g. ai_report.generate / ai_report.view) or remove export.status_report from READ_ONLY role. Currently viewer can list/generate/download PDF.
Optionally add admin.config check on GET /connectors/{type}/config to match spec (token is masked so low risk).
critical_code_review_comments: ConnectorModal missing state — pure oversight (build didn't catch since ESLint no-undef rule is disabled and JiraLinksTab tab is opt-in). Consider enabling no-undef in ESLint config to catch these at build time.
Connectors.jsx is 824 lines — split ConnectorModal, JiraLinksTab, LogsTab into separate files.
Permission strings hard-coded in router (`export.status_report`) — no central constant/enum. A typo could silently allow/deny access.

success_rate.backend: 73% (11/15) — the 4 failures are permission-model mismatches, all core happy-path endpoints pass
success_rate.frontend: 80% — AI Report modal, portfolio Jira badge, home drift all fully working; only Jira 'Projets liés' tab is broken

seed_data_creation: None permanent. Objective 63284d2c... target-value set to 9 during test then restored to 11 (verified drift block disappeared on /home). Jira config and Phoenix→WEB link were not modified. One AI report generation was performed (well within the 2-generation budget).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Report feature is fully functional end-to-end (backend + UI). Home drift block works perfectly. Portfolio Jira badge works. The blocker is a missing useState in ConnectorModal — a 1-line fix. After main agent adds the useState declaration, re-run only the frontend Jira admin/connectors test: open Jira card → click 'Projets liés' tab → verify jira-links-tab / jira-link-project-0 / jira-link-key-0 / jira-link-add / jira-link-remove-0 selectors + add/remove line behavior. Backend permission questions (viewer 403 vs 200 on ai-report endpoints and jira config GET) require product decision, not a fix.
rca of the issue: ConnectorModal (Connectors.jsx) uses `links` and `setLinks` at two locations (handleSave line ~286, JiraLinksTab render line ~369) without declaring them with useState. When the user clicks the 'Projets liés' tab, React tries to render JiraLinksTab({ links, setLinks }) → ReferenceError: links is not defined → React error overlay. Reproduction: login admin → /admin/connectors → click 'Configurer' on Jira card → click 'Projets liés' tab → error overlay appears. Fix: add `const [links, setLinks] = useState((connector.field_mapping?.project_links || []).map(l => ({...l})));` near the other useState calls (~line 237).
